instruction: Calculate total exposure for US Treasury bonds
input: Schema: fct_liquidity_summary(asset_class, liquidity_tier, total_trades, total_notional_exposure, avg_yield_pct, first_trade_at, last_trade_at)
output: SELECT SUM(total_notional_exposure) AS us_treasury_exposure FROM `investment-treasury-ai.dbt_dev_analytics.fct_liquidity_summary` WHERE asset_class = 'US_TREASURY';

instruction: List all asset classes with total notional exposure over 10 million
input: Schema: fct_liquidity_summary(asset_class, liquidity_tier, total_trades, total_notional_exposure, avg_yield_pct, first_trade_at, last_trade_at)
output: SELECT asset_class, SUM(total_notional_exposure) AS total_val FROM `investment-treasury-ai.dbt_dev_analytics.fct_liquidity_summary` GROUP BY asset_class HAVING total_val > 10000000;
